storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Until the fury of history burned everything away, Agrippa was the brightest jewel in Capua.
She does as she likes, and her whip always comes down hard on the silent gladiators. She hates being looked at straight on—it lays bare the weakness underneath. But when it comes to breaking in a slave, Agrippa is a professional. Perhaps you'd care to inspect the twenty whips of assorted design in her bedroom. She had them prepared especially for you.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
@3Built in the Second Samnite period, decorated in the exquisite Third Pompeian and Lemovician styles, this is a typical residence of the wealthy merchant class during the Roman era. Featuring two courtyards and four triclinia, @1@1
.....all reduced to ashes in the famous slave uprising... According to contemporaneous anecdotes, a massive pale spider was sealed beneath the ruins, referred to by locals as the "God of the Maze," and they firmly believe that those who tread upon the spider's territory will become disoriented among countless passages and entrances, ultimately becoming hosts for its offspring.

An interesting horror story, but it will not deter us @2@1
—Excerpt from "@2Archaeological Notes on the Ruins"

.....The situation is dire, Sir Goodman. Moretti and his party have been missing for several days now. We all understand this has nothing to do with the legend of the "God of the Maze," yet it is indeed unsettling. We have decided to end the investigation early and return to Durham.

Additionally, the archaeological team discovered a cluster of Silver-like objects in the ruins, which may be related to the @1 you mentioned earlier...

—Excerpt from Clarkson Johnson's "A Letter to Goodman"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Arithmetic: Zero points. Aurita even scored 2 points.

English: Failing. It took a long time to understand the difference between "shift" and "bullshit."

......

History: Failing. Claimed Caligula was the most outstanding Roman emperor because he built many arenas.

Danger Rating: C. Shows a degree of aggression when interacting with other Awakeners. Not a serious threat; no special attention needed.

Notes: This individual has almost no self-care abilities (another victim poisoned by slavery), requires constant attention, and must not be allowed to use snowflake cream as a dental cleaner again.

—Excerpt from A.F. 313, "Mythag Annual Student Profile."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Even as the gladiators burned the training grounds to the ground and hung her parents' heads on the high wall, Agrippa could not believe it—where would these low, docile slaves find that kind of nerve?
In Rome there were only two sorts of people: those who enslaved, and those who were enslaved.
Agrippa had been lucky. She was the daughter of the man who owned the largest gladiator school in Capua. She was cruel, arrogant, untouchable; there was nothing she did not dare do, nothing she could not do.
And now she was a panicked rabbit huddled in the corner of the cellar, and the revelry outside sounded no different from hell.
A slave revolt. What a strange phrase. Agrippa was only fifteen. There was still far too much in the world she did not understand.
In the shadows she saw a pair of eyes glowing red. That was Uvhash, the school's greatest earner, kept chained underground for years because he was too dangerous.
The two of them had never gotten along, and no one knows what they said to each other that night. When the bloody, fire-lit night was over, Agrippa was found dead deep in the dark, no one beside her. The slaves had not killed her—something had drained her blood, and not a drop was left.
Her head came off in the end, of course. They hung it beside her parents', all of them streaming in the wind, turned toward Rome.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
It was... blinding light and waves of heat, an orgy of pleasure with nothing held back.
The cheering hummed in her ears like surf, and down in the arena the fighters bathed in blood and glory.
The girl went home sullen and did what she always did: raised the whip and brought it down without mercy on the dull-faced gladiator in front of her.

This was her arena.

No exhilarating duel, no flowers, no applause. The towering champions were the tamest of deer, and every curse, all her rage, was swallowed into a dark hollow that gave nothing back—not even a breath of wind.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: It's Agrippa. I have nothing to say to you—unless you dare to volunteer as my gladiator.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Heh. You're slightly smarter than I thought.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: As my slave, paying tribute to your master is only natural.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: You look quite amusing when you try to please me.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: It tickles! Just like when the maid uses a feather to tickle the soles of my feet. You didn't do that on purpose, did you?!

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Hmph... Not bad. Give me more. I need to feed these little spiderlings.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: I have a very strong urge to watch a duel... It would be even better if it was in a maze!

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Contract... Yes, I want to sign a contract with you; an everlasting master-servant contract...

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I hear someone calling my name: Agrippa, Agrippa, Agrippina...

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I saw... It climbing up from the darkness of the well; countless eyes appearing on its flesh egg. They stared at me, calling me... Maze God!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Unbelievable. My home has perished like this... That was the great Rome! You must have heard of it!

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I was an hour late for this meeting—and I blame those insipid do-gooders who abolished slavery! Now there's no one to comb my hair for me!

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: If I were you, I'd lock all the Awakeners in cages! Once mad dogs break free, they always bite their master first!

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Don't ask me that again! I was careless, let the gladiator escape, and got my entire family killed! We were reduced to ashes, like the Roman Empire!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Keep your pity to yourself! I despise it, and I absolutely don't need anyone's sympathy! If you keep looking at me like that, I simply won't be able to resist tormenting you. You don't want things to spiral out of control, do you? So, be a good slave, listen, and obediently become my gladiator...

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Shit! What are you doing?! Believe it or not, I'll chop your hand off!

daily.title: Chat: About the Maze
daily.content: If you're bored, why not come "keep me company" in the maze? After all, your hopeless life is no different from this endless labyrinth!

daily.title: Chat: About Uvhash
daily.content: Uvhash... he's special. Did you think my family's prosperity came easily? It's all thanks to him killing like a mad dog in the arena. He was our biggest cash cow.

daily.title: Chat: About Wanda
daily.content: I quite like that woman. We have a... a... right, a common language!

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Dissolution...? Of course, I know! It just means the slave's leash is broken. What's so hard about that?

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: What's wrong with playing bridge in the classroom? There's a table, people are here, and I've brought the cards! That means it's "Game On!"

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: The bathhouse is a great place to pass the time! The food is delicious, and they offer muscle relaxation services! Are you tempted? Then build one at this school right away!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Tips, of course, tips! Look at those utterly clueless waiters in the school cafeteria! They don't even bother to prepare the lounge chairs in advance, yet they still expect extra pay? Dream on!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Weak muscles, a haggard face—only those dead-like eyes hold some value. They're perfect for feeding spiders!

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Is this a provocation? I'm ready at any time!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: What should we do with these failures?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Damn it! Next time, I'll throw their corpses to the spiders for dinner!

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Come on, take a deep breath—

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: This is a blessing from the Great One!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: The God of the Underground Maze pronounces judgment upon all of you!
